items.label: decor_pumpkin_lantern
items.subject: A carved orange jack-o-lantern with curling green stem, warm amber eyes and jagged grin, mounted on a single rough square timber post and tiny wooden cap.

items.label: Tượng mèo đen bằng gỗ
items.subject: A carved dark-purple wooden Halloween cat statue seated with an elegantly curled tail, pointed ears, one tiny orange neck bow, amber eyes. Clearly a rustic wood carving with a stable little wooden foot, not a living cat, cute and cosy. NO post, no slab, no pedestal or ground tile. Retain only the integral little wooden foot where specified.

items.label: Biển gỗ Halloween
items.subject: A crooked rustic wooden garden signpost with a pumpkin-shaped sign and a bat-shaped arrow, decorated with autumn leaves and a small cobweb. The sign contains ONLY carved pumpkin and bat pictograms, absolutely NO writing, lettering or numbers.

One squat black iron brazier on three short feet with THREE large glowing orange coal rocks inside; NO flame plume. Preserve this exact original habitat, no unrelated parts. The THREE short BLACK IRON feet are stubby, less than one-tenth of the body height. NO long legs, no wood.
